summary: Sun Communities, Inc., as general partner of Sun Communities Operating Limited Partnership, filed an 8-K reporting an October 1, 2026 Thirteenth Amendment creating Series M Preferred Units and the issuance of 283,126 units at $100.00 per unit, roughly $28.3 million, to an initial holder as consideration for an asset contribution. Units pay quarterly distributions of 3.2% for the first year, 3.4% the second, then 3.6%, are exchangeable into common at a $174.00 conversion price, and redeemable for cash at $100.00 from October 1, 2027, ranking senior to common and Series A-3 OP units.
